description: This file defines an interface for managing the 'products' table in a database. It includes functions to ensure table existence, list, count, retrieve, create, update, and delete product records, with search and filter capabilities.

methods.name: ensureProductTable()
methods.description: Creates the 'products' table if it does not exist, including indexes.

methods.name: listProducts({ q, category, minPrice, maxPrice, limit = 20, offset = 0 })
methods.description: Lists products with optional search (full-text), category filter, price range, pagination.

methods.name: countProducts({ q, category, minPrice, maxPrice })
methods.description: Counts total products matching optional search and filters, for pagination purposes.

methods.name: getProductById(id)
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its ID.

methods.name: createProduct({ name, description, price, imageUrl, category, stock })
methods.description: Creates a new product record with provided details.

methods.name: updateProduct(id, { name, description, price, imageUrl, category, stock })
methods.description: Updates a product record identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteProduct(id)
methods.description: Deletes a product record by ID.

ctags.name: countProducts
ctags.pattern: /^async function countProducts({ q, category, minPrice, maxPrice }) {$/

ctags.name: createProduct
ctags.pattern: /^async function createProduct({ name, description, price, imageUrl, category, stock }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ name, description, price, imageUrl, category, stock })

ctags.name: listProducts
ctags.pattern: /^async function listProducts({ q, category, minPrice, maxPrice, limit = 20, offset = 0 }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ q, category, minPrice, maxPrice, limit = 20, offset = 0 })

ctags.name: updateProduct
ctags.pattern: /^async function updateProduct(id, { name, description, price, imageUrl, category, stock }) {$/
ctags.signature: (id, { name, description, price, imageUrl, category, stock })
